04d72be28db19ff76975.en: Every sentence starts with a capital letter.
04d72be28db19ff76975.id: Setiap kalimat dimulai dengan huruf kapital.

105c2a71cdf239ee1dfd.en: A telling sentence ends with a full stop.
105c2a71cdf239ee1dfd.id: Kalimat yang memberi tahu sesuatu diakhiri dengan titik (full stop).

b5ae65532eedba048bf3.en: A question ends with a question mark.
b5ae65532eedba048bf3.id: Pertanyaan diakhiri dengan tanda tanya (question mark).

e5f09adc438bee313872.en: A strong feeling or a shout ends with an exclamation mark.
e5f09adc438bee313872.id: Perasaan yang kuat atau teriakan diakhiri dengan tanda seru (exclamation mark).

bf95502e82cda8160f8c.en: Names, places, days and the word I always have capital letters.
bf95502e82cda8160f8c.id: Nama, tempat, hari, dan kata I selalu memakai huruf kapital.

65a7dcc4df430ae9e3d1.en: What time is it? asks something, so it ends with a question mark.
65a7dcc4df430ae9e3d1.id: What time is it? menanyakan sesuatu, jadi diakhiri dengan tanda tanya (question mark).

23ef4fd8a0f02ef78b81.en: Days of the week start with a capital letter: Friday.
23ef4fd8a0f02ef78b81.id: Nama hari diawali dengan huruf kapital (capital letter): Friday.

4a18d5729b5416e4458c.en: Do you like bananas? asks something, so it ends with a question mark.
4a18d5729b5416e4458c.id: Do you like bananas? menanyakan sesuatu, jadi diakhiri dengan tanda tanya (question mark).

3fbdb4df870f1e167c0f.en: What a big wave that is! shows surprise. It ends with an exclamation mark.
3fbdb4df870f1e167c0f.id: What a big wave that is! menunjukkan rasa terkejut. Kalimat ini diakhiri dengan tanda seru (exclamation mark).

63ef0bc0fa823a0a7983.en: Telling sentences end with a full stop, questions with a question mark and strong feelings with an exclamation mark.
63ef0bc0fa823a0a7983.id: Kalimat berita diakhiri dengan titik (full stop), kalimat tanya dengan tanda tanya (question mark), dan perasaan yang kuat dengan tanda seru (exclamation mark).

bec4928ee5d9514dd02b.en: His name is Omar. starts with a capital letter, has a capital for the name and ends with a full stop.
bec4928ee5d9514dd02b.id: His name is Omar. diawali dengan huruf kapital, memakai huruf kapital untuk nama, dan diakhiri dengan titik.

37121fd8242e7c00b768.en: A sentence starts with a capital letter.
37121fd8242e7c00b768.id: Kalimat (sentence) dimulai dengan huruf kapital (capital letter).

91b91e551e65cb27d621.en: On starts the sentence. Saturday is a day, Rio is a name and I is always a capital.
91b91e551e65cb27d621.id: On mengawali kalimat. Saturday adalah nama hari, Rio adalah nama, dan I selalu ditulis dengan huruf kapital.

6dabd90973c7c2312107.en: It is hot today. We can swim in the pool. That is two sentences.
6dabd90973c7c2312107.id: It is hot today. We can swim in the pool. Itu dua kalimat.

3579ee90f59ef795fec4.en: The sun set. The sky turned orange. The full stop goes after set.
3579ee90f59ef795fec4.id: The sun set. The sky turned orange. Titik (full stop) ditulis setelah set.

7c7d63bde3c2d7239fe4.en: Can you help me?, Look out! and We are going home. all have a capital letter and the right end mark.
7c7d63bde3c2d7239fe4.id: Can you help me?, Look out! dan We are going home. semuanya punya huruf kapital dan tanda akhir yang benar.

cd57e153e593b2eb71ca.en: I means me, and it is always a capital letter.
cd57e153e593b2eb71ca.id: I berarti aku, dan selalu ditulis dengan huruf kapital.

ddf0c18af473f84a0fef.en: Wow, you made a cake! shows surprise. It ends with an exclamation mark.
ddf0c18af473f84a0fef.id: Wow, you made a cake! menunjukkan rasa terkejut. Kalimat ini diakhiri dengan tanda seru (exclamation mark).

d9773d62b31f6ccb3fb2.en: Where are you going? starts with a capital letter and ends with a question mark.
d9773d62b31f6ccb3fb2.id: Where are you going? diawali dengan huruf kapital dan diakhiri dengan tanda tanya.

b8b4af2feccf94bd682b.en: Surabaya is the name of a city, so it needs a capital S.
b8b4af2feccf94bd682b.id: Surabaya adalah nama kota, jadi perlu huruf S kapital.

e65e8dd4b4e2cff9fad4.en: Where did you find the shell? starts with a question word and ends with a question mark.
e65e8dd4b4e2cff9fad4.id: Where did you find the shell? diawali dengan kata tanya dan diakhiri dengan tanda tanya.

e1d12941008fa4141629.en: My starts the sentence, and I is always a capital: My cat and I like the sun.
e1d12941008fa4141629.id: My mengawali kalimat, dan I selalu ditulis dengan huruf kapital: My cat and I like the sun.

e2531b7919e6459f2bf4.en: My needs a capital, Ana is a name, and the sentence tells something, so it ends with a full stop.
e2531b7919e6459f2bf4.id: My perlu huruf kapital, Ana adalah nama, dan kalimat ini memberi tahu sesuatu, jadi diakhiri dengan titik (full stop).

91763bec526dd85a9dc4.en: I can swim tells, Can you swim asks and Let's go is excited. Only one group has the right marks.
91763bec526dd85a9dc4.id: I can swim memberi tahu, Can you swim bertanya, dan Let's go penuh semangat. Hanya satu kelompok yang tandanya benar.

491e9a4bfa1a1a35c239.en: Can you see the moon? A question ends with a question mark.
491e9a4bfa1a1a35c239.id: Can you see the moon? Kalimat tanya diakhiri dengan tanda tanya (question mark).

db8de873e67ebde13a33.en: Both we swim on Monday and on Monday we swim are correct. The cards have no capital letters, so either order works.
db8de873e67ebde13a33.id: Keduanya benar, baik we swim on Monday maupun on Monday we swim. Kartunya tidak punya huruf kapital, jadi kedua urutan itu bisa dipakai.

e259af4a9aa674cbc685.en: Where is my hat? asks something.
e259af4a9aa674cbc685.id: Where is my hat? menanyakan sesuatu.

228ce0c6f663fcc13207.en: What a lovely day! shows excitement.
228ce0c6f663fcc13207.id: What a lovely day! menunjukkan rasa gembira.

af5123380c07852520b3.en: We went to the zoo. has a capital letter and a full stop.
af5123380c07852520b3.id: We went to the zoo. punya huruf kapital dan titik.

da0d13809a6461781890.en: What time is it needs a question mark.
da0d13809a6461781890.id: What time is it perlu tanda tanya (question mark).

9eed5d19285cf177af95.en: Do you like mangoes? is a question.
9eed5d19285cf177af95.id: Do you like mangoes? adalah kalimat tanya.

8c22d1440a03eaf7318e.en: Telling sentences take a full stop, questions take a question mark and big feelings take an exclamation mark.
8c22d1440a03eaf7318e.id: Kalimat berita memakai titik (full stop), kalimat tanya memakai tanda tanya (question mark), dan perasaan yang besar memakai tanda seru (exclamation mark).

52525d9dc3b5a0a82d73.en: What a big fish! shows surprise.
52525d9dc3b5a0a82d73.id: What a big fish! menunjukkan rasa terkejut.

6532800d1b09355ae46f.en: How old are you? asks about age.
6532800d1b09355ae46f.id: How old are you? menanyakan umur.

5b219ebb61b2d7a2a687.en: Please sit down. tells someone what to do.
5b219ebb61b2d7a2a687.id: Please sit down. menyuruh seseorang melakukan sesuatu.

8ab2c1f2c199bacb5b1f.en: A question mark shows that someone is asking something. Example: What is your name?
8ab2c1f2c199bacb5b1f.id: Tanda tanya (question mark) menunjukkan bahwa seseorang sedang bertanya. Contoh: What is your name?

487a331e41bad8036999.en: It is a question, so it ends with a question mark: How old are you?
487a331e41bad8036999.id: Ini kalimat tanya, jadi diakhiri dengan tanda tanya (question mark): How old are you?

3462826f180b3b0d6189.en: A telling sentence ends with a full stop. Example: I like apples.
3462826f180b3b0d6189.id: Kalimat berita diakhiri dengan titik (full stop). Contoh: I like apples.

937c495e66f427d25836.en: Exclamation marks show surprise, excitement or loud shouting. Example: Look at that big dog!
937c495e66f427d25836.id: Tanda seru (exclamation mark) menunjukkan rasa terkejut, rasa gembira, atau teriakan keras. Contoh: Look at that big dog!

2ecba6e1b75d4b135d1a.en: It is not asking anything. It shows strong feeling, so it ends with an exclamation mark.
2ecba6e1b75d4b135d1a.id: Kalimat ini tidak menanyakan apa pun. Kalimat ini menunjukkan perasaan yang kuat, jadi diakhiri dengan tanda seru (exclamation mark).

d00e93f4680dbf3290a9.en: A sentence starts with a capital letter and ends with a full stop, a question mark or an exclamation mark.
d00e93f4680dbf3290a9.id: Kalimat diawali dengan huruf kapital dan diakhiri dengan titik, tanda tanya, atau tanda seru.
